policy: A broad source about a feast cannot prove a highly particular local household practice.
Sources confirming only one component retain that bounded scope.
Historical bibliography without independent attestation remains readable research, not publishable devotional guidance.
Documented lack of corroboration is not a claim that a practice never occurred.

records.title: Christ Child gift-bearer and prayer before opening gifts
records.unverified_claim: The Christkind gift-bearer and family prayer are broad cross-regional claims; only the Austrian gift-announcing bell is presently evidenced.
records.reopen_condition: Exact independently witnessed household prayer and locality needed before publishing a prescribed-sounding practice.

records.title: Twelve Christmas nights as devotional domestic evenings
records.unverified_claim: A Polish public agency attests the older term Święte Wieczory for the Christmas cycle but not a defined series of twelve household devotional evenings.
records.reopen_condition: A period-local witness must show actual repeated family devotions and dates, not merely the name of the season.

records.title: Father blesses family on Jan 1
records.unverified_claim: No exact independent French/French-Canadian Catholic witness for a father blessing household members specifically on 1 January.
records.reopen_condition: Find a dated Catholic household manual or ethnographic text establishing minister, gesture and occasion; distinguish a parent's prayer from priestly blessing.

records.title: Surrexit Dominus vere Easter greeting
records.unverified_claim: Contemporary Catholic bishops use the Resurrection greeting, but this does not establish the early Latin household greeting claimed by the Weiser observation.
records.reopen_condition: Historical independent evidence for the Latin formulation and social greeting custom, not simply a current liturgical acclamation.

records.title: Easter open house and family visits
records.unverified_claim: Family Easter visits are a broad cultural event without evidence of one discrete Catholic practice universal to the listed countries.
records.reopen_condition: Identify a named local custom with date, distinctive action and documented Catholic connection.

records.title: Ascension mountain climbs and hilltop family picnics
records.unverified_claim: Central European Ascension hikes and picnics are not independently verified as a particular Catholic custom distinct from local secular outings.
records.reopen_condition: Named community and dated firsthand or institutional evidence linking the outing to Ascension devotion.

records.title: Wooden dove suspended over household dining table
records.unverified_claim: The precise hanging of a wooden dove above the household dining table lacks an independent local witness.
records.reopen_condition: Museum object, dated photograph or direct ethnographic record specifying the home/dining-table use.

records.title: Pentecost dawn hilltop prayer
records.unverified_claim: Pentecost dawn hilltop prayer is not yet distinguishable from other seasonal sunrise or pilgrimage practices.
records.reopen_condition: Local Catholic parish or ethnographic account of the prayer, place and date.

records.title: Cross-shaped last sheaf decorated in household
records.unverified_claim: The southern French cross-shaped last harvest sheaf custom remains without exact independent local corroboration.
records.reopen_condition: Museum collection or local heritage account attesting construction, placement and seasonal purpose.

records.title: Spanish balcony candles and flowers for 8 December
records.unverified_claim: General Marian decorations and 8 December processions do not verify the exact Northern Spanish custom of balcony candles and flowers.
records.reopen_condition: Named parish/city and dated first-hand description of residential balconies for 8 December.

records.title: Annunciation picture among seed grain with prayer
records.unverified_claim: The Austrian image of the Annunciation placed among seed grain with prayer has not been independently documented.
records.reopen_condition: Named regional ethnographic archive or church source distinguishing the domestic act from priestly seed blessing.

records.title: Our Lady of Grape Harvest family festive meal
records.unverified_claim: French Marian vineyard festival meals cannot be inferred from separate evidence for grape blessings or harvest customs.
records.reopen_condition: Direct named vineyard locality and dated Marian harvest meal witness.

records.title: Breton all-night prayer bells and farmhouse visits
records.unverified_claim: All-night Breton bells and farmhouse visits are unverified as one discrete Catholic devotion.
records.reopen_condition: Breton diocesan/ethnographic independent witness for the precise night, caller, prayers and household visits.

records.title: Eight days of family Soul Nights after All Souls
records.unverified_claim: No exact independent witness of a Central European eight-day household Soul Nights observance after All Souls.
records.reopen_condition: Dated source explicitly showing eight evenings, household prayers and precise region.

records.title: Daily charitable meal portions during Soul Nights
records.unverified_claim: Daily charitable meal portions during Soul Nights may belong to a wider almsgiving family, but exact duration and action remain unverified.
records.reopen_condition: Independent local documented practice with food recipient, chronology and relationship to All Souls.

records.title: Beans peas lentils as food given to poor
records.unverified_claim: General food gifts for the poor at All Souls do not independently establish the exact beans, peas and lentils claim over Western Europe.
records.reopen_condition: A direct local historical/ethnographic source for legumes, recipient and commemoration date.

records.title: Hungarian orphan children invited for All Souls
records.unverified_claim: Specific invitations of Hungarian orphan children for All Souls have not been corroborated beyond the book locator.
records.reopen_condition: Hungarian period record or local institutional evidence that states who hosted children on which date.
